displayDescription: A rigged character swings its arm up and points as a glowing node network assembles on a twilight storybook stage.
limitations: Flat 2D SVG puppet rig. Light effects are translucent cream overlays, not physical lighting.
The paper grain is a static seeded feTurbulence overlay, an approximation of a painted texture.

Background colours (#162430, #1C2F3C, #25404D, #1F3644, #1A2C2F) are a new scene-dependent twilight state; the character, node and lettering keep the approved tokens #2C4249, #7A9A91, #C7876F and #F4EDDF.
Rim light (cream stroke at 50% opacity) was added behind the ink legs so they separate from the dark sky.
PixiJS, Rough.js and Motion are installed but were not needed; Blender was not used, as instructed.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent.
